left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  The diagnosis of pseudoachondroplasia is based on clinical assessment either in person  [OR] or by photographic review by skeletal dysplasia specialist (JTH),
  -  Healthy beyond pseudoachondroplasia associated complications,
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Current use of resveratrol
  -  Current use of blood thinners, [OR]  lovastatin, [OR]  ketoconazole, [OR]  itraconazole, [OR]  fexofenadine  [OR] and triazolam

right.raw_text: -  Other non-pseudoachondroplasia related health conditions, e

left.raw_text: Women must use adequate contraception during the study
-  Participation in another clinical study  [OR] and/or using investigational agents

right.raw_text: -  Use of Non-steroid anti-inflammatory (NSAIDs) [OR]  or aspirin

left.raw_text: -  Current use of Alfentanil, [OR]  Cyclosporine, [OR]  Dihydroergotamine, [OR]  Dofetilide, [OR]  Ergotamine, [OR]  Fentanyl, [OR]  Flibanserin, [OR]  Oxycodone, [OR]  Pimavanserin, [OR]  Pimozide, [OR]  Quinidine, [OR]  Saquinavir, [OR]  Sirolimus, [OR]  Tacrolimus, [OR]  Temsirolimus, [OR]  Theophylline, [OR]  Tizanidine, [OR]  Thioridazine, [OR]  Fosphenytoin, [OR]  Phenytoin  [OR] or Warfarin
-  Baseline level of pain of 2 or higher on 10 point scale

right.raw_text: -  Platelet count below 50,000 per ul on baseline complete blood count (CBC)
